Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding of this requirement.
口语版
Before I dive in, I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about this requirement. ## 关键表达 - be on the same page about something：对某件事有一致理解，常用于确认需求、计划或分工；职场中也很常用。 - dive in：开始投入做某事，比 get started 更口语。 ## 生硬译法改进 生硬：Before doing it, I want to confirm our understandings are consistent.
自然：Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding.
原因：Before doing it 指代模糊；our understandings are consistent 虽能理解，却像逐字翻译。英语中更常说 have the same understanding 或 be on the same page。 ## Markdown 表达日志 ```markdown ### 2026-10-22｜职场：确认理解一致 - 中文：开始做之前，我想先确认一下，我们对这个需求的理解是一致的。 - 专业版：Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding of this requirement. - 口语版：Before I dive in, I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about this requirement. - 关键表达：be on the same page = 对某事有一致理解；dive in = 开始投入做某事。 - 改进：把 “our understandings are consistent” 改为 “we have the same understanding” 或 “we’re on the same page”，更符合英语习惯。 ``` The SQLite table definition for this page's parent data source.
